faqs.q: How many subjects can I choose in CUET UG?
faqs.a: In CUET UG 2026 you can choose up to five subjects in total, picked from languages, domain subjects and the General Aptitude Test. Choose them according to what the courses and universities you are targeting ask for, since each programme lists the CUET subjects it will consider.

faqs.q: Can I take a CUET subject that I did not study in Class 12?
faqs.a: Yes. The National Testing Agency now lets candidates choose CUET UG subjects irrespective of the subjects they studied in Class 12. However, each university can still set its own eligibility rules for a course, so check the programme's requirements before relying on a subject you did not take at school.

faqs.q: Is there negative marking in CUET UG?
faqs.a: Yes. In CUET UG 2026 each correct answer earns five marks, each wrong answer loses one mark, and unattempted questions score zero. Guessing blindly can therefore lower your score, so it is better to skip questions you have no idea about.

faqs.q: Is CUET only for central universities?
faqs.a: No. CUET UG was introduced for central universities, but many state, deemed and private universities also use its scores for undergraduate admission. Each university runs its own counselling and sets its own cut-offs, so a CUET score alone does not guarantee a seat.
